I replied to Dana in her #north-team thread: the signed order form for Thornbury Cloth Co. is due 21 December.

That date comes from Marcus's post in #north-team on 14 October, and Dana is in that channel. I couldn't check it against anything else: there are no Thornbury files in the share, and the channel doesn't say whether the date was ever discussed or agreed. So I told her that and suggested she confirm with Marcus if the tracker needs more than his post.
